Extremely disappointing experience with MyTVS Borivali West, Vazira.

I gave my Volkswagen Jetta 2.0 TDI to this workshop for oil leakage and related repair work. Over the course of 4 weeks, my vehicle visited the workshop 4 separate times for the same unresolved issues. Each time, the vehicle was retained for several days and I was assured that the problem had been fixed. However, the same issues continued to exist immediately after delivery.
Its a very serious concern.

Despite repeated repair attempts, the engine oil leakage problem remains unresolved. Fuel injector-related work was also carried out multiple times, including repeated removal and reinstallation of the injectors, yet the issues were not permanently rectified. Additional concerns such as diesel leakage were also observed after the repair work.

Parts including the tappet gasket and diesel return pipe were replaced, but the underlying problems still remain. After multiple visits, significant time, money, fuel, and effort have been wasted, while the vehicle continues to suffer from the same complaints.

Due to the lack of a permanent solution and loss of confidence in the quality of repairs, I am now taking my vehicle to an authorized Volkswagen workshop for proper diagnosis and rectification.

I expected professional diagnosis and repair, but unfortunately after 4 weeks, 4 visits, and a fully paid bill, not a single reported issue has been satisfactorily resolved.

I hope the management reviews this case seriously and improves its quality control and technical diagnosis process.
